lines: Dicam, Sicculique pœtæ
Narrabo interitum: Deus immortalus haberi
Dum cupit Empedocles, ardentem frigidus
Aethnam.
Inſiluit ius, liceátque perire pœtis.
Toutesfois il fuſt bien fruſtré de ſon eſperance: car
l'impetuoſité du feu reietta dehors les petites pantouf-
fles detain qu'il ſouloit porter. ce que deſcouurit toute
ſon ambition & impoſture. Or reuenans à nos moutõs
c'eſt vne choſe fort villaine, laſche, indigne d'vn Chre-
ſtien, & treſdeſplaiſante à Dieu, de vouloir deuancer ſes

garde l'ame qu'il nous à donnée, Et ſi tu as prins à gar-
der de l'argent, ou des bagues, ou autres choſes de ton
amy, ſi tu en vſes mal, tu es à fort bonne raiſon eſtimé

ſe ſi precieuſe, qu'eſt l'ame, laquelle Dieu t'a commiſe,
& ballice en garde.
Voyant que ce proditeur luy auoit deſ-

que par ſentence du Iuge de Rieux fut

uncertain.note: final E of THOLOSE and the stop after it are poorly inked (E looks like a broken sort, stop looks like a small comma/curl); read as 'THOLOSE.'
'Sicculique' sic (double c) as printed; 'pœtæ' read with œ ligature, could be 'poetæ'
'immortalus' as printed (Horace has 'immortalis'); the final glyph pair is the same italic 'us' shape as in 'Deus'; possibly an 'is' ligature misread, sic otherwise
sic, 'Aethnam' for Aetnam; line printed indented as a turnover of the preceding verse line but it is a separate printed line
'Inſiluit' read with long s; 'ius' as printed (Horace: 'sit ius'); accent on 'liceátque' as printed

uncertain.text: fles detain qu'il ſouloit porter. ce que deſcouurit toute
uncertain.note: 'detain' as printed (for d'eſtain), sic; stop after 'porter' read as a period, followed by lowercase 'ce'

uncertain.text: que le Seigneur nous appelle: duquel nous auons en
uncertain.note: the stop after 'appelle' is an odd shape (two dots slightly offset, lower one tailed); read as colon, could be a semicolon

uncertain.text: garde l'ame qu'il nous à donnée, Et ſi tu as prins à gar-
uncertain.note: 'garde': the r is broken and looks like an undotted i ('gaide'); read as damaged r. 'donnée' accent sits over the second e

uncertain.text: meſchant, deſloyal, & peruers: à plus grande occaſion
uncertain.note: a small stray mark (apostrophe- or ſ-like) is printed between 'grande' and 'occaſion'; treated as a stray/spacing sort, not transcribed
'ballice' as printed, sic (for baillee); the letter before the final e could be c or e

uncertain.text: robé ſon honneur, & l'opinion de ſa cha
uncertain.note: h of 'cha' broken, looks like 'cla'; read as 'cha'

uncertain.text: ſteté, elle incontinent mit en Iuſtice le
uncertain.note: 'Iuſtice' poorly inked, u and ſ partly broken

uncertain.text: condemné perdre la teſte, & eſtre mis &
uncertain.note: 'mis &' as printed (sense wants 'mis à quatre quartiers'); sic
